name: agent-workspace
description: Monorepo: @agent/contracts (seam), @agent/harness (agent loop), durable-agent-runtime (durable host), @agent/coding-agent (sandbox coding workload).

scripts.build: npm run build -w @agent/contracts && npm run build -w @agent/harness && npm run build -w durable-agent-runtime && npm run build -w @agent/coding-agent
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @agent/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @agent/harness && npm run typecheck -w durable-agent-runtime && npm run typecheck -w @agent/coding-agent
scripts.test: npm run build -w @agent/contracts && npm run test -w @agent/harness && npm run test -w durable-agent-runtime && npm run test -w @agent/coding-agent
